comment: Minimal PDF-signed invoice submission payload aligned with SoumissionFacture.to_payload()
description: Example payload expected by /v1/soumettre after /v1/deposer/pdf has returned pieceJointePrincipaleId
importantNotes: numeroFactureSaisi is the invoice number extracted from the PDF
pieceJointePrincipaleId is the Chorus attachment id returned by /v1/deposer/pdf
Do not confuse numeroFactureSaisi with pieceJointePrincipaleId
This payload is intentionally minimal and omits optional fields such as pieceJointeComplementaire, commentaire, idUtilisateurCourant and codeServiceExecutant
howToUse: 2. Read pieceJointeId from the upload response
3. Build the JSON payload with extracted invoice fields and Chorus context ids
